CHD_2012_p60__caption_0.ocr:
SPD net sales were $254.9 million for 2012, a decrease of $6.2 million, or 2.4% as compared to 2011. The
components of the net sales change are the following:

CHD_2012_p60__paragraph_0.ocr:
The sales volume decrease in 2012 reflects reduced product sales of certain animal nutrition products,
partially offset by higher pricing. The reduction in net sales is also due to unfavorable foreign exchange rates and
the adverse impact in the first quarter of 2012 of a timing shift in customer orders from the first quarter of 2012
to the fourth quarter of 2011 in anticipation of the January 1, 2012 information systems upgrade in the U.S.

CHD_2012_p60__paragraph_1.ocr:
SPD income before income taxes was $33.8 million in 2012, an increase of $4.2 million as compared to
2011. The increase in the income before income taxes for 2012 primarily reflects higher selling prices partially
offset by lower sales volume, higher raw material costs of certain animal nutrition and performance products and
foreign exchange rates.

CHD_2012_p60__caption_1.ocr:
SPD net sales were $261.1 million for 2011, an increase of $2.0 million, or 0.8% as compared to 2010. The
components of the net sales change are the following:

CHD_2012_p60__caption_2.ocr:
(1)
Product lines divested include the BRILLO product line, which was divested in the first quarter of 2010.

CHD_2012_p60__paragraph_2.ocr:
The pricing increase in 2011 reflects higher sales prices in response to raw material increases primarily in
the animal nutrition and performance products businesses. The sales volume decrease reflects lower U.S. exports.
The discontinued product line reflects the Company’s decision in late 2010 to cease a foreign subsidiary’s sale of
a certain chemical product line.

CHD_2012_p60__paragraph_3.ocr:
SPD income before income taxes for 2011 was $29.7 million, an increase of $10.9 million as compared to
2010. The increase in income in 2011 reflects the profits on higher net sales and lower allocated interest expense
partially offset by higher raw material costs. Income before taxes in 2011 also includes $3.0 million in charges
associated with the Company’s decision to exit the chemical business in Brazil. Income before Taxes in 2010
includes expenses of $9.7 million associated with an increase in environmental reserves of $4.9 million and an
impairment and plant shutdown charge of $4.8 million, both related to the Company’s Brazilian subsidiary. Cost
of sales in 2010 includes $7.6 million of these charges and SG&A includes the remaining $2.1 million.
